native_before_owner.qualification: The native owner selects one actual COMMITTED_CURRENT head, otherwise its own exact initial authorised TSFIN authority. The automatic consumer adds no fallback, current price or guessed history. approval_basis.coverage_complete must be true with the exact current root/family/candidate/client scope.

native_approval_basis.HEAD_saved_work_detail: Actual private.bpay_next_source_chosen_detail row keyed by exact head/component/decision_bundle/bundle_revision; component_sha256 and detail_sha256 verified. detail_json pins work_date, start/end/overnight/break_minutes and five rates. No Banking worktree was read.
native_approval_basis.TSFIN_saved_detail: Exact approved invoice_breakdown_json.segments, additional_units_json, actual_schedule_json and rate_source_refs_json; policy_snapshot_json pinned under WEEKLY_SOURCE_APPROVED_POLICY_V2. Authorised current root/version and one current root authorisation are required.

native_canonical_component.required_comparison: Compare every canonical component identity/membership and finance field using this native composer/content owner. Trace exclusions are only the three native exclusions; never drop policy, rate, additional, expense or work identity drift. Preserve native duplicate/cardinality checks.

actual_stage_owner.binding: Approval approved_target_pay_components_json equals exact sealed target_snapshot. Generation complete_next_vector_hash covers the full object including automatic selection. Request native financial_row_id/request_sha256 and actual source/approval/run/event provenance are checked.

target_component_composition.critical_distinction: Stage vector.components contains C1 transport components with request-specific IDs/kinds. It must NOT be compared directly to I-1 stable canonical entitlement components.
target_component_composition.actual_composer: private.weekly_source_entitlement_components_v1(sealed TSFIN invoice_breakdown_json.segments, exact saved/proved Source expense observations)
target_component_composition.identity: Calculated output ordinal maps to the same accepted schedule event; segment_id=weekly-source-event:<event UUID>, weekly_protected_component_identity.work_event_id=<same UUID>. Native identity manifest pins accepted schedule, calculator segments and exact prior approved components. No clock/date historical join.
target_component_composition.expense_gate: Every Source expense observation, generation/revision, event and document hash must equal the saved native Source evidence and sealed C1 record. Missing/unreadable/changed evidence refuses; no expense_code parsing or live-expense substitute is a new authority.
target_component_composition.additional_gate: Exact saved code/unit/rate/pay/charge evidence is validated by the native mapper; stable member identity is additional:<physical booking family>:<code>. Total-only equality never qualifies.
target_component_composition.manual_route: Existing individual manual native reconciliation remains unchanged.

native_own_stage_bound_normalisation.actual_checks: Native STAGE_C1_REQUEST step pins allowlisted owner/signature, COMPLETE outcome/clock, request/run/generation/family identity, before/after/response hashes and bounded response. Only the proven stage K-to-K+1 family bound increment is normalised before comparing complete fresh and sealed inventories. No unrelated growth or rotation is normalised.
native_own_stage_bound_normalisation.phase_restriction: This helper requires a genuine native LOCAL PREPARING/PENDING_FREEZE receipt. It is unavailable before complete_local allocates that receipt. Root's earlier stage/delta assertion must purpose-reuse the exact native step checks without fabricating a PREPARING receipt or invoking this helper out of phase.

root_owned_assertion.capability_authority: Existing controlled activation/feature receipt and exact latest VERIFIED release plus qualified actual assertion, not function presence, a new readiness table or a hardcoded true value.
assertion_requirements: Exact configured active protected-pay actor; actual RECONCILE run and request/approval/financial row identity.
Exact native frozen before inventory, original component membership/identity/signature and current approved root/authorisation/head/bundle witness.
Whole sealed generation/request/vector hash and actual target snapshot, component manifest and native canonical target composition.
Fresh exact Source publication/scope/rules/binding/export/snapshot/receipt CAS equals the sealed server selection; native owner/policy/rate/expense/additional drift refuses.
Full canonical component equality and exact saved policy/rate evidence; delta_pay_ex_vat alone is insufficient.
Missing, stale, growing, contradictory or changed evidence raises WEEKLY_SOURCE_AUTOMATIC_RECONCILE_DELTA_UNAVAILABLE before automatic native completion.
root_owned_assertion.stage_rollback: Assertion runs after actual immutable stage rows/vector are written but before that same stage transaction returns. Refusal rolls the entire stage RPC back. Preflight refuses before prepare if qualified capability/assertion is absent. A later race may leave an existing native preparation run, so ordinary recovery must be truthful and proved.
root_owned_assertion.completion: Fresh assertion is repeated under Candidate gate -> complete native I-1 -> group UPDATE -> cycle UPDATE, before unchanged complete_local. Only actual PUBLISHED yields cleared/audit; SAVED_PENDING_FREEZE refuses and rolls back this completion.

immutable_fixture.scope: Actual JS transport and identity producer, with explicitly synthetic calculator/RPC inputs. It pins target/transport shape, never SQL admission, approved inventory or a zero certificate.
immutable_fixture.native_fixture_required: Root must produce exact authorised HEAD and initial authorised TSFIN vectors plus real sealed stage/generation/approval/expense evidence in the protected TEST rehearsal; source mocks do not satisfy this gate.
